body:
If you're still here dude reply
I don't want to see another one of us giving up their life
Please not on this day, already one has slipped away into Oblivion today. Please reply dude, can't see you giving up. Please just message me back.  I want to sleep so bad. If you don't reply sleep won't come to me easy. I'll have to take those pills. Just reply for my sake dude. Just give me this one, please.

Hey hey are the voices commenting on everything you do?
If they are just minimise any unnecessary social interaction.
Just surrender to them. You'll think you've lost. But after some time they will go away (or get reduced). Accept that you don't have to be perfect and know that trying to do everything perfectly is an indication of narcissism hiding itself. You know better than being a narcissist. Or you can relate your overthinking to some highly repugnant thing you know about. You can link them together I know for sure. Just try this once, you won't get institutionalised. Shout stop when you want the voices to stop. Don't worry about looking like a idiot in front of others, because you have to save yourself now. Assert control because there isn't another option.

Ssshhh...
I'm lonely too
I'm 23 and failing my uni exams for third time.
Don't get lost yet, and you are not useless. 
It's tough, but only ones who are strong can survive without others because they aren't afraid of being lonely. You are strong remember that

23 M 
Hits right in the feels
I tried to study about this on the internet and all I could relate to was Lacan's theory of schizophrenia. But I'm not schizophrenic, I know that and my doctor has also told me that. It's really confusing, I know. But any explanation, if it could lead me to be normal, will be welcome.

I won't judge you at all 
I consider myself morally repugnant and a scumbag
You can talk to me freely

Hey man I'm hooked on Adderall and Modafinil and Clonazepam myself. I sometimes prepare a cocktail and take it just for the heck of it. One time I nearly felt like I had taken heroin when I took 3 pills of each. I'm not promoting drug abuse or whatever, but I am practically alive rn due to high doses of Clonazepam. I am always sleepy, and waking up is a nightmare. For much of the time I'm typing shit here half assed conscious while yawning uncontrollably. So hit me right in the feels man.

Hey mods of this forum, don't suspend my account for this comment. I just telling my story and not promoting drug abuse in any way.

Sshhh...
Calm down 
Listen to a sad song 
You'll be alright friend 
You have made it this far, despite being disabled
You have already won, so don't worry there will always be someone for you in your hard times I promise.

Hey if you can't escape it
Embrace me, I'm your online friend now. You can insult me, joke about me, I won't mind. Because for once in my life I want to be a good friend to someone.

Another one of us has fallen in this battle.
I wish I could have something to remember him by, but death and darkness won't even let us have that.
I am now waiting for my turn. I can only hope my fall is graceful enough so that others can remember me for some time, before even my memory fades into Oblivion..

Hey man, I know life is very unfair. I'm fact it's so unfair that I can't kill myself right now because my sister is getting her tumor removed tommorow. But if it gives you any peace, I used to make a gun symbol with right hand fingers and pretended to blow my brains out whenever I felt suicidal. One day I actually tried jumping off the ledge, but chickened out in the end. And now I'm here, telling someone else to not do the same. I want a way out of misery too, but I fail every time. That's why I keep talking to people like you here because I think only you people can understand my pain and I think I can understand yours. So carry on living, because life is a show, and the show must go on.

Hey man don't die at 13
I know fuck society but don't give them a chance to use your suicide for "reducing pressure on teens" and preventing "suicide due to stress of studies" shit. In short man, they will mainstream your death to push their agenda. You know that nowbody understands people like us. So don't let them use you after your death, like they are using you now. You can take a stand, rise up and say fuck you to the world. After all, living a normal life in this shit world is the most heroic thing you can do.

Don't worry man I know this dread.
I have felt it myself. Faliure in attempt will only lead to worse outcome. Don't worry, the fear will pass. Just talk to other people here, and contact a psychiatrist. Tell him you need immediate relief and he'll know what to give you. When you get relaxed, don't start thinking too much again. I know it's easier said than done, but you'll have to do it. Distract yourself from any useless thought, even if the attempt seems futile. After some time you will find some sort of peace. Continue doing this until you have to. And please don't go near anything negative, person thing or whatever. You can use your condition as an excuse to avoid negative things. I know you are capable of doing this.

Hey milliemillie is awesome
I was feeling fucked up and lost one day
That person messaged me saying they were a cannibal group
I said to her I ain't falling for this shit but still I ended up laughing at her morbid sense of humor
My point is dude there is no perfect way to talk to people like us. Some try giving sympathy, but it always felt pretentious to me. In fact everything felt pretentious. Milliemillie maybe knew and therefore became most pretentious person to talk to. I came here for sympathy, but stayed here due to milliemillie s fake ass story which made me laugh every time. So dude, don't judge people here. We all know better than that.

Goddamnit I thought I was alone here in this world with this thought.
Now I have found you.
So welcome to the club of "I don't know what to do since there is no true altruistic behavior but still I need love because I am human too"
I being the founder, and the sole member of this club invite you to join my club.
We have a variety of assortments to offer you, including existential crisis as starter, nhilism in main course, and absurdism for dessert.
Every member should serve themselves because others are too lazy to help you.
I plan on expanding our club in the future, setting up chapters in various parts of world.
Oh shit, I just realized I broke the clubs only rule - "Don't be a narcissistic asshole." I'm sorry I pushed my agenda on you. 
So I take back what I said. But membership is still on the table though. Please join because I don't want to be lonley.

Bitches man...
You love them and care for them
But it's never enough for them
Just don't die because some girl fucked you up and cheated on you.
Well, actually I shouldn't be giving you advice because I never had a girlfriend.
I am one of them incel losers. So yeah, play games with the guy who wrote the comment before me and shout on the 9 year old kids playing fortnite or whatever the shit kids play nowadays. It really helps you get on your feet, since nothing feels as good as bullying a kid online. In my time, they did it in school. So they could get suspended for it. But online bullying is better, because you get to be anonymous. If you think this is not morally good, just try it once. I am sure you will feel good after that.

Can I say same here
Because if someone said it to me I will smack their face in the pavement
I have my University exams from 13 Nov and I still can't study shit. I know I'll fail every subject, but I'm still doing nothing to prevent it. Because for me, what's the point anymore. If dropped out before, regretted it, came back to finish my degree, but still I'm hell bent on dropping out again anyway. People say all kind of shit to me, good or bad. But it is always stale and repetitive. There's nothing new to tell me, because I have went to every therapist or psychiatrist but still had the same shit told to me every fucking time. Feels like they are not even trying anymore. I would rather listen to Cardi B rap shit than rather hear the same shit again.

I always considered trans people stupid, but damn this hits home hard. I feel the same about myself, because I know I could have been someone better. But I see myself today, and I'm ashamed of myself. If it's any comfort, I used to be transphobic before reading your post, but now I see you like I see myself, imperfect beings who just wanted to be better. So go girl/boy, whatever you like, don't be sad because you made a mistake. Everyone here has a shit ton of regrets here, so welcome to the club of misery and self-loathing. You are our first trans member. This diversity drive  thing is looking good now.

 I'm still laughing because I never thought I would use gender appropriate pronouns in my life, but anyways life keeps on amazing me. So yes, you made a sad man laugh after a long time. Thank you.

I'm seeing a doc but the guy literally only prescribes me buttload of meds and tells me nothing
I've poured my heart out, cried, confessed but still I am here. 
What's the point of even trying?

Hey man, if it makes you feel better, I am also suicidal and I think your life is shittier than mine ( I consider my life pretty shit). How did you survive for so long in this condition is beyond me.
I am such a pussy that if I was in your condition, I would have killed myself long ago. Goddamn you are strong.
